import * as component_1 from '@kne/current-lib_responsive-utils';
import * as component_2 from 'antd';
const readmeConfig = {
    name: "responsive-utils",
    summary: "<h3>统一响应式基础设施</h3>\n<p><code>@kne/responsive-utils</code> 为 KNE 前端项目提供统一的断点 token、React Hooks、弹窗边界与滚动容器上下文，替代各业务包中分散的 <code>768px</code> 判断与 <code>getPopupContainer</code> 实现。</p>\n<h3>主要特性</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>统一断点</strong>：<code>BREAKPOINTS</code>、<code>MOBILE_BREAKPOINT</code>（768px）与 SCSS mixin 一处维护</li>\n<li><strong>React Hooks</strong>：<code>useIsMobile</code>、<code>useBreakpoint</code>、<code>useMediaQuery</code>、<code>usePopupContainer</code>、<code>useScrollElement</code></li>\n<li><strong>上下文 Provider</strong>：<code>ResponsiveProvider</code> 支持视口模式与容器模式（设备预览框）</li>\n<li><strong>DOM 工具</strong>：<code>findScrollParent</code>、<code>resolveBoundaryElement</code>、<code>resolveScrollElement</code></li>\n</ul>\n<h3>使用场景</h3>\n<ul>\n<li>后台管理页根据移动端/桌面端切换布局与交互</li>\n<li>antd <code>Select</code>、<code>DatePicker</code> 等浮层挂载到正确边界，避免被父级 <code>overflow: hidden</code> 裁剪</li>\n<li>滚动容器内 sticky、锚点、虚拟列表需要获取真实滚动根</li>\n<li>example-driver 手机预览框内按设备宽度模拟 <code>useIsMobile</code></li>\n</ul>",
    description: "Unified responsive breakpoints, hooks, popup boundary and scroll context for KNE projects.",
    packageName: "@kne/responsive-utils",
    api: "<h3>断点 Token</h3>\n<p>统一断点常量，与 SCSS mixin 同源。</p>\n<h4>导出</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>BREAKPOINTS</code></td>\n<td><code>Record&lt;string, number&gt;</code></td>\n<td><code>{ xs:0, sm:576, md:768, lg:992, xl:1200, xxl:1600 }</code></td>\n<td>断点像素值</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>MOBILE_BREAKPOINT</code></td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>768</code></td>\n<td>移动端阈值，等于 <code>BREAKPOINTS.md</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>IS_MOBILE_QUERY</code></td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>(max-width: 768px)</code></td>\n<td><code>matchMedia</code> 查询字符串</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>BREAKPOINT_KEYS</code></td>\n<td><code>string[]</code></td>\n<td><code>['xs','sm','md','lg','xl','xxl']</code></td>\n<td>断点 key 列表</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>SCSS</h3>\n<p>容器查询使用统一名称 <code>kne-responsive</code>（<code>$responsive-container-name</code>），业务方无需硬编码。</p>\n<p><strong>宿主元素</strong>（如 example-driver 的 <code>.example-driver-preview-content</code>）：</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-scss\">@use '@kne/responsive-utils/scss' as resp;\n\n.preview-host {\n  @include resp.responsive-container;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>子元素样式</strong>：</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-scss\">@include resp.mobile-container { ... }\n@include resp.container-down(md) { ... }\n@include resp.mobile { ... } // 视口 @media\n</code></pre>\n<h3>响应式目标类名</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>类名</th>\n<th>用途</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-responsive-container</code></td>\n<td>容器查询宿主（配合 <code>responsive-container</code> mixin）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-responsive-boundary</code></td>\n<td>弹层挂载边界（<code>getPopupContainer</code> / <code>usePopupContainer</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS</code></td>\n<td><code>kne-responsive-scroll</code></td>\n<td>滚动参照容器（<code>useScrollElement</code> / Affix / BackTop）</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>DOM 查找：<code>findResponsiveBoundary(anchor)</code>、<code>findResponsiveScroll(anchor)</code>。无自定义注入时 Provider 默认按类名解析，再回退 <code>body</code> / <code>documentElement</code>。</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-jsx\">&lt;div className={RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_CLASS} /&gt;\n&lt;div className={RESPONSIVE_BOUNDARY_CLASS}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;\n&lt;div className={RESPONSIVE_SCROLL_CLASS}&gt;{children}&lt;/div&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>容器查询（JS / 内联样式）</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>名称</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>containerMobileBlock(rules)</code></td>\n<td>生成移动端 <code>@container</code> 规则块，无需知道容器名</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>containerDownBlock('sm', rules)</code></td>\n<td>按断点 key 生成容器查询块</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>RESPONSIVE_CONTAINER_NAME</code></td>\n<td>高级场景用，一般不必直接使用</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-js\">import { containerMobileBlock } from '@kne/responsive-utils';\n\nconst css = `\n  .box { background: blue; }\n  ${containerMobileBlock('.box { background: green; }')}\n`;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>ResponsiveProvider</h3>\n<p>为子树注入响应式上下文，控制移动端判定、弹窗边界与滚动容器。</p>\n<h4>属性</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>mode</code></td>\n<td><code>'viewport' | 'container'</code></td>\n<td><code>'viewport'</code></td>\n<td>视口模式或容器宽度模式</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>containerWidth</code></td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td><code>container</code> 模式下用于 <code>useIsMobile</code> / <code>useBreakpoint</code> 的宽度</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getBoundaryElement</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义弹窗挂载边界</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getScrollElement</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义滚动参照元素</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>boundaryRef</code></td>\n<td><code>RefObject&lt;HTMLElement&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>边界 DOM ref，优先级低于 <code>getBoundaryElement</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scrollRef</code></td>\n<td><code>RefObject&lt;HTMLElement&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>滚动容器 ref</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scrollAnchorRef</code></td>\n<td><code>RefObject&lt;HTMLElement&gt;</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>从锚点向上解析滚动父级</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>useIsMobile</h3>\n<p>判断当前是否为移动端（宽度 &lt; 768px）。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isMobile</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>视口或容器宽度是否小于 <code>md</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>无 Provider 时回退到 <code>(max-width: 768px)</code> 的 <code>matchMedia</code>。</p>\n<h3>useBreakpoint</h3>\n<p>返回各断点命中状态与 <code>isMobile</code>。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xs</code> ~ <code>xxl</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>当前宽度是否达到对应断点</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>isMobile</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>同 <code>useIsMobile</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>useMediaQuery</h3>\n<p>订阅任意 CSS media query。</p>\n<h4>参数</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>query</code></td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标准 media query 字符串</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>matches</code></td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>查询是否命中</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><code>container</code> 模式下对含 <code>max-width</code> 的 query 会映射到 <code>getIsMobile()</code>。</p>\n<h3>usePopupContainer</h3>\n<p>返回 antd <code>getPopupContainer</code> 回调。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getPopupContainer</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>弹窗挂载边界 getter</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>useScrollElement</h3>\n<p>返回滚动容器 getter。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getScrollElement</code></td>\n<td><code>() =&gt; HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>滚动参照元素 getter</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>DOM 工具</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>函数</th>\n<th>参数</th>\n<th>返回值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>findScrollParent</code></td>\n<td><code>(element: HTMLElement)</code></td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement | null</code></td>\n<td>向上查找最近可滚动祖先</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>resolveBoundaryElement</code></td>\n<td><code>(boundaryRef?)</code></td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>解析边界元素，默认 <code>document.body</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>resolveScrollElement</code></td>\n<td><code>(scrollRef?, anchor?)</code></td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>解析滚动元素，默认文档滚动根</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getDefaultScrollElement</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>默认滚动根</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>getDefaultBoundaryElement</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td><code>HTMLElement</code></td>\n<td>默认 <code>document.body</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>",

        list: [{
    title: "快速入门",
    description: "断点 token 与核心 Hooks 一览，展示视口模式下的移动端判定与断点状态",
    code: "const {\n  BREAKPOINTS,\n  MOBILE_BREAKPOINT,\n  IS_MOBILE_QUERY,\n  useIsMobile,\n  useBreakpoint\n} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Card, Descriptions, Flex, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useMemo} = React;\n\nconst BreakpointTags = () => {\n  const breakpoints = useBreakpoint();\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n\n  const activeKeys = useMemo(\n    () => Object.keys(breakpoints).filter((key) => key !== 'isMobile' && breakpoints[key]),\n    [breakpoints]\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"断点 Token\">\n        <Descriptions column={1} size=\"small\">\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"MOBILE_BREAKPOINT\">{MOBILE_BREAKPOINT}px</Descriptions.Item>\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"IS_MOBILE_QUERY\">{IS_MOBILE_QUERY}</Descriptions.Item>\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"BREAKPOINTS\">\n            {Object.entries(BREAKPOINTS)\n              .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${value}`)\n              .join(' / ')}\n          </Descriptions.Item>\n        </Descriptions>\n      </Card>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"实时响应式状态\">\n        <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n          <Typography.Text>\n            当前设备：\n            <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'blue'}>{isMobile ? '移动端' : '桌面端'}</Tag>\n          </Typography.Text>\n          <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">已命中断点：{activeKeys.join(', ') || 'xs'}</Typography.Text>\n        </Flex>\n      </Card>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<BreakpointTags />);\n\n",

    name: "_ResponsiveUtils",

    importStatement: "import * as _ResponsiveUtils from \"@kne/responsive-utils\"",

    name: "antd",
    packageName: "antd",
    component: component_2

},{
    title: "ResponsiveProvider",
    description: "视口模式与容器模式对比，演示 boundaryRef / scrollRef 自定义弹窗边界与滚动容器",
    code: "const {ResponsiveProvider, useIsMobile, usePopupContainer, useScrollElement} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Card, DatePicker, Flex, InputNumber, Select, Switch, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useRef, useState} = React;\n\nconst PRESET_WIDTHS = [\n  {label: 'iPhone SE (375)', value: 375},\n  {label: 'iPad Mini (768)', value: 768},\n  {label: 'iPad Pro (1024)', value: 1024},\n  {label: 'Desktop (1440)', value: 1440}\n];\n\nconst ProviderDemo = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();\n  const getScrollElement = useScrollElement();\n  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);\n\n  React.useEffect(() => {\n    const el = getScrollElement();\n    const onScroll = () => setScrollTop(el.scrollTop);\n    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive: true});\n    onScroll();\n    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);\n  }, [getScrollElement]);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Typography.Text>\n        Provider 判定：\n        <Typography.Text type={isMobile ? 'warning' : 'success'} strong>\n          {isMobile ? '移动端布局' : '桌面端布局'}\n        </Typography.Text>\n      </Typography.Text>\n      <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">滚动容器 scrollTop：{scrollTop}px</Typography.Text>\n      <Select\n        style={{width: 200}}\n        placeholder=\"选择部门\"\n        getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer}\n        options={[\n          {label: '研发中心', value: 'rd'},\n          {label: '产品中心', value: 'pm'},\n          {label: '运营中心', value: 'ops'}\n        ]}\n      />\n      <DatePicker getPopupContainer={getPopupContainer} placeholder=\"选择生效日期\" />\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst ResponsiveProviderExample = () => {\n  const [useContainerMode, setUseContainerMode] = useState(true);\n  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(375);\n  const boundaryRef = useRef(null);\n  const scrollRef = useRef(null);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Flex gap={16} align=\"center\" wrap=\"wrap\">\n        <Flex gap={8} align=\"center\">\n          <Typography.Text>容器模式</Typography.Text>\n          <Switch checked={useContainerMode} onChange={setUseContainerMode} />\n        </Flex>\n        {useContainerMode && (\n          <Flex gap={8} align=\"center\">\n            <Typography.Text>模拟宽度</Typography.Text>\n            <InputNumber\n              min={320}\n              max={1600}\n              value={containerWidth}\n              onChange={(v) => setContainerWidth(v || 375)}\n            />\n            <Select\n              style={{width: 180}}\n              value={containerWidth}\n              onChange={setContainerWidth}\n              options={PRESET_WIDTHS}\n            />\n          </Flex>\n        )}\n      </Flex>\n      <div\n        ref={boundaryRef}\n        style={{\n          position: 'relative',\n          border: '1px dashed #91caff',\n          borderRadius: 8,\n          padding: 12,\n          background: '#f0f5ff'\n        }}\n      >\n        <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n          boundaryRef 区域（浮层挂载到此）\n        </Typography.Text>\n        <div\n          ref={scrollRef}\n          style={{\n            height: 180,\n            overflow: 'auto',\n            border: '1px solid #d9d9d9',\n            borderRadius: 6,\n            padding: 12,\n            background: '#fff'\n          }}\n        >\n          <div style={{height: 320}}>\n            <ResponsiveProvider\n              mode={useContainerMode ? 'container' : 'viewport'}\n              containerWidth={useContainerMode ? containerWidth : undefined}\n              boundaryRef={boundaryRef}\n              scrollRef={scrollRef}\n            >\n              <ProviderDemo />\n            </ResponsiveProvider>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <Card size=\"small\">\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{margin: 0}}>\n          切换「容器模式」后，useIsMobile 按 containerWidth 判定而非浏览器视口；boundaryRef / scrollRef\n          覆盖默认的 body / documentElement。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n      </Card>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<ResponsiveProviderExample />);\n\n",

    importStatement: "import * as _ResponsiveUtils from \"@kne/responsive-utils\"",

    title: "useIsMobile",
    description: "监听视口或容器宽度，驱动布局切换与条件渲染",
    code: "const {ResponsiveProvider, useIsMobile, MOBILE_BREAKPOINT} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Card, Col, Flex, InputNumber, Row, Switch, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\nconst LayoutPreview = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n\n  return (\n    <Card\n      size=\"small\"\n      title={\n        <Flex gap={8} align=\"center\">\n          <span>订单列表</span>\n          <Tag color={isMobile ? 'orange' : 'geekblue'}>{isMobile ? '移动布局' : '桌面布局'}</Tag>\n        </Flex>\n      }\n    >\n      {isMobile ? (\n        <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n          {['ORD-20240701-001', 'ORD-20240701-002', 'ORD-20240701-003'].map((id) => (\n            <Card key={id} size=\"small\" type=\"inner\">\n              <Typography.Text strong>{id}</Typography.Text>\n              <br />\n              <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">客户：华东分公司 · ¥12,800</Typography.Text>\n            </Card>\n          ))}\n        </Flex>\n      ) : (\n        <Row gutter={[12, 12]}>\n          {['ORD-20240701-001', 'ORD-20240701-002', 'ORD-20240701-003'].map((id) => (\n            <Col key={id} span={8}>\n              <Card size=\"small\">\n                <Typography.Text strong>{id}</Typography.Text>\n                <br />\n                <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">客户：华东分公司 · ¥12,800</Typography.Text>\n              </Card>\n            </Col>\n          ))}\n        </Row>\n      )}\n    </Card>\n  );\n};\n\nconst UseIsMobileExample = () => {\n  const viewportIsMobile = useIsMobile();\n  const [simulateContainer, setSimulateContainer] = useState(false);\n  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState(414);\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Card size=\"small\">\n        <Descriptions viewportIsMobile={viewportIsMobile} />\n      </Card>\n      <Flex gap={12} align=\"center\" wrap=\"wrap\">\n        <Flex gap={8} align=\"center\">\n          <Typography.Text>模拟容器宽度</Typography.Text>\n          <Switch checked={simulateContainer} onChange={setSimulateContainer} />\n        </Flex>\n        {simulateContainer && (\n          <InputNumber\n            min={320}\n            max={1200}\n            addonAfter=\"px\"\n            value={containerWidth}\n            onChange={(v) => setContainerWidth(v || 414)}\n          />\n        )}\n      </Flex>\n      {simulateContainer ? (\n        <div style={{width: containerWidth, border: '1px solid #f0f0f0', borderRadius: 8, padding: 8}}>\n          <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" style={{display: 'block', marginBottom: 8}}>\n            容器宽度 {containerWidth}px（阈值 {MOBILE_BREAKPOINT}px）\n          </Typography.Text>\n          <ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\" containerWidth={containerWidth}>\n            <LayoutPreview />\n          </ResponsiveProvider>\n        </div>\n      ) : (\n        <LayoutPreview />\n      )}\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst Descriptions = ({viewportIsMobile}) => {\n  const {Descriptions: AntDescriptions} = antd;\n  return (\n    <AntDescriptions column={1} size=\"small\">\n      <AntDescriptions.Item label=\"视口 useIsMobile\">\n        {viewportIsMobile ? 'true（< 768px）' : 'false（≥ 768px）'}\n      </AntDescriptions.Item>\n      <AntDescriptions.Item label=\"典型用途\">侧栏折叠、表格卡片化、底部操作栏</AntDescriptions.Item>\n    </AntDescriptions>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UseIsMobileExample />);\n\n",

    title: "useBreakpoint",

    code: "const {BREAKPOINTS, useBreakpoint} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Card, Flex, Progress, Tag, Typography} = antd;\n\nconst BREAKPOINT_META = [\n  {key: 'xs', label: '超小屏', desc: '手机竖屏'},\n  {key: 'sm', label: '小屏', desc: '手机横屏 / 小平板'},\n  {key: 'md', label: '中屏', desc: '平板 / 小笔记本'},\n  {key: 'lg', label: '大屏', desc: '桌面'},\n  {key: 'xl', label: '超大屏', desc: '宽屏桌面'},\n  {key: 'xxl', label: '巨屏', desc: '4K / 超宽'}\n];\n\nconst UseBreakpointExample = () => {\n  const breakpoints = useBreakpoint();\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={16}>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"断点命中状态\">\n        <Flex vertical gap={10}>\n          {BREAKPOINT_META.map(({key, label, desc}) => {\n            const active = breakpoints[key];\n            const width = BREAKPOINTS[key];\n            return (\n              <Flex key={key} justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\">\n                <Flex gap={8} align=\"center\">\n                  <Tag color={active ? '命中' : '未命中'}</Tag>\n              </Flex>\n            );\n          })}\n        </Flex>\n      </Card>\n      <Card size=\"small\" title=\"侧栏宽度示意\">\n        <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n          <Typography.Text>\n            isMobile：\n            <Tag color={breakpoints.isMobile ?     code: "const {ResponsiveProvider, useMediaQuery, useIsMobile, IS_MOBILE_QUERY} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Card, Flex, InputNumber, Switch, Tag, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useState} = React;\n\nconst CUSTOM_QUERIES = [\n  {label: '紧凑模式 (max-width: 576px)', query: '(max-width: 576px)'},\n  {label: '宽屏 (min-width: 1200px)', query: '(min-width: 1200px)'},\n  {label: '横屏', query: '(orientation: landscape)'},\n  {label: '深色偏好', query: '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'}\n];\n\nconst QueryRow = ({label, query}) => {\n  const matches = useMediaQuery(query);\n  return (\n    <Flex justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\">\n      <Typography.Text>{label}</Typography.Text>\n      <Tag color={matches ? 'success' : 'default'}>{matches ? '匹配' : '不匹配'}</Tag>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nconst MediaQueryPanel = () => {\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Flex justify=\"space-between\" align=\"center\">\n        <Typography.Text>IS_MOBILE_QUERY</Typography.Text>\n        <Tag color={isMobile ? (\n        <ResponsiveProvider mode=\"container\" containerWidth={containerWidth}>\n          <Card size=\"small\" title={`容器 ${containerWidth}px`}>\n            <MediaQueryPanel />\n          </Card>\n        </ResponsiveProvider>\n      ) : (\n        <Card size=\"small\" title=\"视口模式\">\n          <MediaQueryPanel />\n        </Card>\n      )}\n      <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\" code>\n        {IS_MOBILE_QUERY}\n      </Typography.Text>\n    </Flex>\n  );\n};\n\nrender(<UseMediaQueryExample />);\n\n",

    code: "const {ResponsiveProvider, usePopupContainer, useIsMobile} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Card, DatePicker, Flex, Select, Tooltip, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useRef} = React;\n\nconst DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS = [\n  {label: '研发中心 / 前端组', value: 'fe'},\n  {label: '研发中心 / 后端组', value: 'be'},\n  {label: '产品中心 / 设计组', value: 'design'},\n  {label: '运营中心 / 增长组', value: 'growth'}\n];\n\nconst PopupDemo = () => {\n  const getPopupContainer = usePopupContainer();\n  const isMobile = useIsMobile();\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={12}>\n      <Typography.Text type=\"secondary\">\n        当前 {isMobile ?     code: "const {ResponsiveProvider, useScrollElement} = _ResponsiveUtils;\nconst {Button, Card, Flex, Typography} = antd;\nconst {useEffect, useRef, useState} = React;\n\nconst ScrollMonitor = () => {\n  const getScrollElement = useScrollElement();\n  const [info, setInfo] = useState({scrollTop: 0, clientHeight: 0, scrollHeight: 0});\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const el = getScrollElement();\n    const update = () => {\n      setInfo({\n        scrollTop: el.scrollTop,\n        clientHeight: el.clientHeight,\n        scrollHeight: el.scrollHeight\n      });\n    };\n    update();\n    el.addEventListener('scroll', update, {passive: true});\n    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', update);\n  }, [getScrollElement]);\n\n  const scrollToTop = () => {\n    const el = getScrollElement();\n    el.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'smooth'});\n  };\n\n  const scrollToBottom = () => {\n    const el = getScrollElement();\n    el.scrollTo({top: el.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth'});\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Flex vertical gap={8}>\n      <Typography.Text>\n        scrollTop: {info.scrollTop}px / 可视高度: {info.clientHeight}px / 总高度: {info.scrollHeight}px\n      </Typography.Text>\n      <Flex gap={8}>\n        <Button size=\"small\" onClick={scrollToTop}>\n          滚到顶部\n        </Button>\n        <Button size=\"small\" onClick={scrollToBottom}>\n size=\"small\">\n        <Typography.Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{margin: 0}}>\n          useScrollElement 返回滚动容器 getter，适用于虚拟列表、锚点导航、滚动同步等场景。\n        </Typography.Paragraph>\n      </Card>\n      <div\n        ref={scrollRef}\n        style={{\n          height: 200,\n          overflow: 'auto',\n          border: '1px solid #d9d9d9',\n          borderRadius: 8,\n          padding: 12,\n          background: '#fafafa'\n        }}\n      >\n        <ResponsiveProvider scrollRef={scrollRef}>\n          <ScrollMonitor />\n          <div style={{height: 400, marginTop: 16}}>\n            {Array.from({length: 8}, (_, i) => (\n              <Card key={i} size=\"small\" style={{marginBottom: 8}}>\n                审批单 #{10086 + i} — 差旅报销 · 待部门经理审批\n              </Card>\n            ))}\n <Typography.Text>锚点元素 (.dom-utils-anchor)</Typography.Text>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={inspect}>\n        解析 DOM\n      </Button>\n      {result && (\n        <Card size=\"small\" title=\"解析结果\">\n          <Descriptions column={1} size=\"small\">\n            <Descriptions.Item
